stemMd: What is the purpose of the final sentence?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To claim that room temperature cannot be studied.

options.label: B
options.textMd: To prove placement is the only possible source of error.

options.label: C
options.textMd: To show that instruments have no useful role.

options.label: D
options.textMd: To explain why measurement conditions belong in interpreting a reading.

options.label: E
options.textMd: To recommend replacing every high-reading sensor.

explanationMd: The conclusion broadens attention from instrument identity to instrument-environment interaction. Mounting and heat sources can affect interpretation, so recording them improves understanding. It does not imply that reliable measurement is impossible.

distractorRationale.c: The instruments remain central to measurement.
distractorRationale.b: The passage also mentions shared bias.
distractorRationale.a: The team improves the recording method.
